body:
Set by the Schedules and economy chat after a red team (you asked it to decide, 31 Oct). Base: your pet decision 18.
Yardstick after the rebalance: about 585 coins a game day = 2,300 a real hour of normal play.

PETS
- Normal pets: 200 (as today)
- Monkey, seal, bear, snake: 400
- Farm animals and horses: not for sale (shared town farm)

PET HOMES
- Climbing tree (monkey) 400, snake glass tank 400, pond (seal) 700, cave den (bear) 700, dog house 180 (as today)
- Monkey, seal, bear also need pet yard level 3 + animal license; snake needs a license + its tank

BEDS, BOWLS, TOY BOX
- Pet bed 80 (as today); the 2 new bed styles 100 and 120
- Food bowl 30 (as today), water bowl 30, pet toy box 60

TOYS: every pet toy 20 (feather toy 25)
- Today's toys go up to 20 too (ball, frisbee, yarn ball, toy mouse, squeaky toy were 8-10): same kind, same price. Toys you own stay yours.

TRAINING GEAR (150-300)
- 150: bunny hurdles, hamster wheel and maze, seal beach ball, snake flute and basket
- 200: cat tower, duck ramp and tub, owl perch
- 250: monkey bars, bear log swing, capybara zen bath
- 300: dog agility course

PET ACCESSORIES: orange, green sprout, bubble tea, honey pot: 40 each

BACKYARD (fence, gate, path, decoration come with the level)
- Pet yard: level 1 free, level 2 = 800 (Pet care 20), level 3 = 2,000 (Pet care 40)
- Garden: level 1 free, level 2 = 600 (Gardening 20), level 3 = 1,500 (Gardening 40)

OTHER (decided 31 Oct): vet 50 per pet (free with too few coins), riding lesson 100 once, Market pays 10 for farm eggs and milk, pet food 6 (as today).

WHAT IT COSTS IN PLAY TIME (normal play)
- A normal pet with bed, bowl and 2 toys: 350 = about 9 minutes
- Pet yard to level 3: 2,800 = about 1 hour 15 min (plus Pet care 40)
- First big pet with home and yard: up to 3,900 = about 1 hour 40 min (plus license)
All prices can be changed in Town Timetable after playing.
